xinghai-repeating-beacon.title: The Distress Call Running Backward
xinghai-repeating-beacon.brief: Westwind receives repeated distress pulses whose timestamps move backward. The rubble outpost retains the original relay record. Establish whether anyone is still calling before deciding what to preserve.

objectives.xinghai-repeating-beacon.signal: Establish comparable signal times at Westwind.
objectives.xinghai-repeating-beacon.source: Compare the original relay record at the outpost.
objectives.xinghai-repeating-beacon.resolve: Choose and complete one bounded response at the outpost.

xinghai-repeating-beacon.measure.title: Measure with your radar compass
xinghai-repeating-beacon.measure.description: Use your radar compass and learned orbital calculation, spending 6 energy. Measuring is not piloting a ship out of the station.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.measure.success: Two synchronized readings show a normal carrier period with an abnormal attached timestamp. They do not locate a new caller.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.measure.failure: Interference masks the sample. Incomplete readings are not rescue coordinates.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.measure.success_echo: The original readings remain available for comparison.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.measure.failure_echo: Better preparation is needed; spent time remains real.

xinghai-repeating-beacon.listen.title: Buy the public two-station timing record
xinghai-repeating-beacon.listen.description: Pay 120 Inar and spend two hours comparing public timing copies at the desk. No private channel or radio ownership is granted.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.listen.success: Station clocks agree; only the pulse's attached timestamp repeats backward. The relay attachment is now the specific question.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.listen.failure: A section is missing, leaving a possible station-clock difference unresolved.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.listen.success_echo: The copy serves this investigation, not permanent database access.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.listen.failure_echo: Better preparation is needed; time and fees remain spent.

xinghai-repeating-beacon.trace.title: Compare the original receipt at the outpost
xinghai-repeating-beacon.trace.description: Travel to the rubble outpost and compare your timing record with retained transmission pages. A remote claim is not arrival.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.trace.success: The receipt records a rescue already concluded. After a power change the relay resent a cached segment as new packets. Its looping timestamp explains the repetition; there is no evidence the old caller is still there.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.trace.failure: Sequence numbers do not yet align. The distress call cannot be declared obsolete.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.trace.success_echo: The old call and current equipment fault are distinct. Any new call needs its own date and source.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.trace.failure_echo: Better preparation is needed; spent time remains real.

xinghai-repeating-beacon.repair.title: Repair playback and preserve the relay
xinghai-repeating-beacon.repair.description: Use one heat-resistant insulation unit and learned emergency rewiring, spending 6 energy. Retain the original rescue record.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.repair.success: False replay stops and a test packet carries the current time. The station pays 260 Inar for the repair; the public relay and record remain.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.repair.failure: Control remains unstable. Used insulation cannot be recovered; the relay stays marked for repair.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.repair.success_echo: The repair remains on record without another repair payment on return.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.repair.failure_echo: Better preparation is needed; time and used material remain spent.

xinghai-repeating-beacon.isolate.title: Isolate the old cache with station permission
xinghai-repeating-beacon.isolate.description: At the duty desk, isolate the verified replay branch, retain a copy and recover one authorized old capacitor. The public relay pauses until separately repaired.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.isolate.success: The old call stops repeating and the record stays with the station. You receive one authorized capacitor. The relay is paused, not restored.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.isolate.failure: The branch is unconfirmed. No capacitor can be removed and no stopped replay claimed.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.isolate.success_echo: There is only one recovered capacitor. The relay does not repair itself with time; later restoration needs real work.
xinghai-repeating-beacon.isolate.failure_echo: Better preparation is needed; spent time remains real.
